units.source_text: 我想：明儿一早就去道歉。

en.t: I thought: first thing tomorrow morning, I will go and apologize.

units.source_text: 到了早晨，我又想：今天之内向他道歉吧。

en.t: When morning came, I thought again: I should apologize to him sometime today.

units.source_text: 老师的表情依然没有什么变化。

en.t: The teacher's expression still showed no real change.
